# MEC Public API


<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

## Overview

Re-exports the full public API for `emachines.mec`.

Importing from `emachines.mec` gives access to all public symbols
without needing to know which submodule they live in.

## Usage

``` python
from emachines.mec import *
# or selectively:
from emachines.mec import PermeabilityModel
from emachines.mec import BranchType
from emachines.mec import MECSolution
```
